# DSH Studio v0.9.24

## New features

- Browse workspace folders lazily, filter entries and preview/copy read-only UTF-8 text up to 1 MiB; list at most 1,500 entries per directory.
- Organize up to 500 selected sessions with atomic pins and tag changes, preserving names, notes and bookmarks.
- Import/export prompt JSON and back up/restore personal prompts and session annotations. Review conflicts, keep existing records by default or explicitly replace conflicts; preserve records absent from the backup.

## Changes and safety

- Validate complete batches before one atomic commit. Bind import previews to source/current-library digests, rejecting stale confirmation, malformed/future/oversized input and merge overflow. Exclude credentials, runtime preferences and Harness logs.
- Bound browsing to the current workspace, reject traversal/links/reparse points/binary previews and verify final file-handle paths on Windows. Prevent exports to managed application data. Private shell commands retain public Protocol 3/Host Protocol 1 boundaries.

## Fixes and polish

- Synchronize shell/Harness appearance while preserving System preference; initial saved-settings settling no longer swallows rapid subsequent choices.
- Disable batch controls while search settles, clear selections when the view changes and confirm discarding tag drafts. Reuse modal focus handling and shared controls; update bilingual guides, architecture and actual screenshots, including pending local theme fixes.

## Verification

- Two actual Windows WebView rounds cover dark/light, 900×620 layouts, file navigation/preview/copy, batch persistence, JSON input, canceled/keep/replace imports and stale-preview rejection.
- Regress ten routes, five actual PTYs and three Harness start/stop cycles. Rapid appearance choices synchronize in about one second; first cold startup is slower than subsequent approximately-three-second starts.
- Pass 679 frontend, 577 executed Rust and 158 packaging tests, with 99.36% frontend line coverage, production build/budget, strict Clippy, lint and contract/documentation checks. Paid providers, physical macOS/Linux GUI and OS save-picker clicks are outside local evidence; native export outcomes are verified and platform installers are qualified by release CI.

## Installation

- Upgrade over v0.9.23 retaining runtime, profiles, sessions and personal data. Existing five-platform Lite/Full editions continue; Windows portable builds require adjacent `dist/`. Personal JSON restore does not rewrite Harness logs. Updater and OS publisher signatures remain separate mechanisms.
